name: gridiron-physics
description: Physics-based 22-player reconstruction of a real NFL game from ESPN play-by-play, with a Madden-style rating engine grounded in public research.

scripts.data: python3 pipeline/fetch.py && python3 pipeline/ratings.py && python3 pipeline/build_game.py
scripts.test: node test/validate.mjs --strict && node test/prototype.mjs && python3 test/test_prototype_data.py && node --test test/rigged-player-unit.mjs test/rigged-animation-unit.mjs test/rigged-animation-assets.mjs
